title: Craft crash in northern Iran

tellings.quote: And there was one that crashed and went down in northern Iran that we had to try to go in and

plain: A craft crashed in northern Iran and the United States had to try to go in after it, according to Steven Greer, a UFO researcher who runs a campaign to make government UFO secrets public. Greer mentions it only in passing on a 2025 episode with Jesse Michels, giving no date and no source, saying "there was one that crashed and went down in northern Iran that we had to try to go in." If true, it would mean crash retrievals reach well beyond American soil.
